summary: Implemented the governed TypeScript backend as a long-running Railway API with private PostgreSQL persistence, checksum-locked pre-deploy migrations, a shared bounded scheduler cycle, signed provider callbacks, and a fail-closed public-demo/operator trust boundary that prevents anonymous provider authorization.

commands: npm run build:server && npm run test:server && npm run test:security
Scratch PostgreSQL 17: run npm run migrate:server twice against a fresh database and inspect public.oncoready_schema_migrations
tests.notes: The server build/typecheck passed; 42 focused server, contract, and FHIR tests passed, including a 17-test focused security/webhook subset; all governed contracts validated; and six vendor-neutral migration tests passed. A fresh PostgreSQL 17 rehearsal applied both migrations once, skipped both on the second run, and recorded 64-character SHA-256 checksums. Tests cover deterministic migration ordering, advisory locking, applied-prefix enforcement, checksum/history drift rejection, rollback and secret-safe errors, plus disabled-demo failure, direct non-browser public access, arbitrary scenario/resource/action/role rejection, web-only readiness, server-derived CareLink plans, repository-enforced public no-outbox effects, operator authentication/authorization provenance, health/tick trust boundaries, scheduler non-overlap, idempotency/version guards, caregiver minimization, signed callbacks, deduplication, and transcript non-persistence.

notes_for_next_agent: Configure the Railway api service to use railway/api.toml, the repository root as build context, one replica, sleeping disabled, and DATABASE_URL=${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}. Railway now runs npm run migrate:server as the pre-deploy command after the compiled server build.

The migration runner sorts database/migrations/*.sql lexically, holds a PostgreSQL advisory lock, requires applied history to be an exact prefix, rejects checksum drift before running new SQL, and records each migration transactionally in public.oncoready_schema_migrations without logging connection values.

The process listens on 0.0.0.0:$PORT, exposes database-backed GET /health, runs the same WorkflowApplication.tick cycle from the internal scheduler and authenticated manual endpoint, and waits for an active tick before closing PostgreSQL on SIGTERM/SIGINT.

Public access is enabled only by ONCOREADY_PUBLIC_DEMO_ENABLED=true and is fixed to the illustrative finals scenario. Public reads and commands require no browser credential, while application/repository effect classes prevent every public command from creating provider outbox authorization.

Keep ONCOREADY_OPERATOR_TOKEN server-only. Reset and fixed-recipient SMS/voice initiation require X-OncoReady-Operator-Token; accepted communication outbox payloads persist authorization_source=operator_control before the existing provider switches and allowlists are evaluated.

Readiness is patient/web-only. Work-item and transport commands enforce resource existence, supported resource type, action, current-state, and claimed-role policies. CareLink request creation accepts only work_item_id plus command context and derives the fixed plan from server-owned finals state.

Provider intent is committed before network I/O. Unknown network outcomes become outcome_unknown and are excluded from blind re-claim; signed callbacks reconcile stored attempts by provider conversation/message reference.

ElevenLabs callbacks accept the official signed post_call_transcription and call_initiation_failure envelopes, derive scenario/correlation only from stored provider attempts, return HTTP 200, and persist neither transcript nor audio.

Keep EXTERNAL_ACTIONS_ENABLED, TWILIO_SMS_ENABLED, and ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ENABLED false until Railway variables, fixed recipient, exact public origin, and signed callback preflight pass. No live provider action was performed by this worker.
